clinician.trajectory_summary: A woman in her late 30s presented with progressive bilateral vision loss, right eye more affected, with a past history of brain cyst surgery and a family history suggestive of VHL. Ophthalmic examination revealed bilateral optic nerve head haemangioblastomas and retinal haemangioblastomas. MRI brain showed multiple posterior fossa cystic lesions and right optic nerve haemangioblastoma. Abdominal MRI disclosed bilateral enlarged kidneys with cortical cysts, a soft tissue lesion in the left kidney, and a retroperitoneal lesion indicative of extra-adrenal pheochromocytoma. Clinical follow-up showed progressive severe visual impairment. Genetic testing and biopsy/pathological confirmation were not reported.
